description:
Add an IP or Origin allowlist rule to a Global node.

New rules are deactivated and do nothing until activated. Active IP rules
limit which client IPs can call the node; active origin rules limit which
Origin headers it accepts. With both kinds active, a request must pass
both. Everything else gets HTTP 403 within about 10 seconds. Rules don't
affect the Chainstack API, so they can always be changed or deactivated
with these tools.

Before activating, confirm with the user that the IP rules cover every IP
that calls the node (servers, CI, their own machine); you can't check
this. Origin rules are for browser-only access: once one is active, every
request without an Origin header (servers, scripts, curl) is blocked, even
from an allowed IP.

If an identical rule exists, it is returned instead of a duplicate.

activate.description:
Also activate the rule. Only after the user confirms the
allowlist.

value.description:
For ip, one IPv4 or IPv6 address (no CIDR ranges). For origin,
a host name without scheme or path: example.com, *.example.com
(the domain and its subdomains), or * (any origin). Up to 65
characters.
